**Problems found: 1 blocker, 2 warnings.**

**RUN-03** · blocker · [Verified] — No start command. `package.json` has `build` and `test`
but no `start`. App Service needs to know how to run the app; without it the deploy looks
fine but the site never comes up. **Fix:** add `"start": "node dist/index.js"`.

**RUN-04** · warning · [Verified] — No health endpoint, so the workflow cannot confirm the
app responds after deploying. **Fix:** add a route returning 200, then re-run
`/deploy-check` to gain a health-check step.

**BUILD-05** · warning · [Assumed] — Build output folder unknown; no framework detected, so
`dist/` cannot be assumed safely. **Fix:** confirm where `npm run build` writes and check
the `package:` path matches.

*Not applicable here: all `DOCK-*` (no Dockerfile), all `DATA-*` (no database config).*

## 2. How does the deployment work?

When you push to `main`, GitHub builds your app and copies the result to Azure.

1. You push to `main`.
2. GitHub Actions starts `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.
3. It checks out the code and installs Node 22.
4. It runs `npm ci`, then `npm run build`.
5. It signs in with the publish profile and uploads the built files to `vilje-api-prod`.

**If any step fails the run stops** — a failed build never reaches Azure.

There is no health check after upload, because no health endpoint was found (RUN-04). The
run goes green once files are copied, even if the app does not start — so check the site
yourself until that is fixed.

---

## 3. What do I need to configure?

One-time setup, done by a person.

### GitHub secrets

Repository → **Settings** → **Secrets and variables** → **Actions** → **New repository secret**.

> Secret values never appear in this document and must never be pasted into chat.

| Secret name | What to put in it | Where to get it |
|---|---|---|
| `AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE` | The contents of the publish profile file | Azure portal → your Web App → **Get publish profile** → open the downloaded file and copy all of it |

### Azure resources

**[Unknown]** — the skill cannot see your Azure account and cannot check these exist.

| Resource | Name | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| App Service (Web App) | `vilje-api-prod` | Runtime stack must be Node 22 |

**Publish profile setup**

1. Azure portal → your Web App → **Get publish profile** (a file downloads).
2. Open it in a text editor, copy everything, paste into the secret above.
3. Set the Startup Command in **Configuration → General settings** — the workflow cannot
   set it under publish-profile auth.

If the publishing credentials are ever reset, download the profile again and update the
secret, or deploys fail with an authentication error.

### Before the first push

- [ ] Fix RUN-03 — add a `start` script
- [ ] Confirm the build output path matches `package:` (BUILD-05)
- [ ] App Service `vilje-api-prod` exists, running, Node 22
- [ ] Secret `AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE` added
- [ ] Someone has read `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` and agrees with it

---

## 4. How do I run the deployment?

1. Finish the checklist above.
2. Commit, then `git push origin main`.
3. Open the **Actions** tab. A run named **Deploy to Azure App Service** appears in seconds.

You can also start it by hand: Actions tab → the workflow → **Run workflow**.

**No Azure commands needed.** The workflow does that; section 3 is one-time.

---

## 5. How do I know whether it succeeded?

1. Open the **Actions** tab of this repository.
2. Click the latest run of **Deploy to Azure App Service**.
3. Green tick = every step passed. Red cross = click the failed step for the log.
4. Then open `https://vilje-api-prod.azurewebsites.net`.

Step 4 matters here: with no health check, a green run only proves the files uploaded.

### Already checked

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| YAML parses, `on:` and `jobs:` present, runner declared | Passed |
| Permissions scope — `contents: read` only | Passed |
| Auth method — publish profile with App Service, a valid pair | Passed |
| Action versions pinned, no `@main` | Passed |
| No inline secrets; trigger scoped to `main`; concurrency set | Passed |

**Not performed:** expression errors (`actionlint` not installed); App Service exists with
the right runtime (no Azure access); the secret is present and current (no repo settings
access); the app starts and serves traffic (nothing was executed); build and tests
(`--run-build` not set).

> YAML validation confirms syntax and structure only. It does not prove the deployment
> will succeed. Azure resources, permissions, quotas and network paths are unverified.

### If it fails

| Symptom | Likely cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Deploy step fails with an authentication error | Publish profile secret missing, wrong, or invalidated by a credential reset | Download the profile again, update the secret |
| Green run, but the site errors | No start command (RUN-03) | Add a `start` script and push again |
| Green run, but the default Azure page shows | `package:` points at the wrong folder (BUILD-05) | Check where `npm run build` writes |
| "App not found" | Name mismatch or wrong subscription | Confirm `vilje-api-prod` in the portal |

Re-check anytime with `/deploy-check validate`.
